Hi Samantha — thanks for the intake. Quick clarifications from Redwood privacy/legal: 

1) Controller confirmation: per our DPA (section 3.2) we require an explicit controller affirmation when requests are submitted on behalf of data subjects by an organization. Please reply to this thread with a short statement on OmniHealth letterhead confirming (a) you are the controller for the listed identifiers, and (b) you are authorized to request access/erasure on behalf of the individuals. If you prefer, we can accept a signed PDF.

2) Identity verification: for bulk requests we require proof that the submitting party is authorized. If OmniHealth can supply a signed form (example attached: "controller_affirmation_template.pdf"), that will speed processing.

3) Evidence packet: Redwood will prepare an evidence bundle that includes:
   - full data export scoped to the manifest (CSV + JSON payloads where applicable)
   - system logs showing when data was created/modified (redacted to the requested identifiers)
   - reference to the DPA clause and current SCCs in effect (we will include PDF copies)
   - an audit log of deletion actions and backup purge dates once deletion is executed

Marcus — can you confirm ETA for the export and whether we can produce deletion audit proofs for backups (S3 lifecycle, snapshot purge) by the 2027-04-21 target? If not, propose alternative timeline.

Samantha — once we have the affirmation and ID verification, we will queue this as a priority DSR.

Regards,
